title: OpenAI Introduces New Business Profiles for ChatGPT
excerpt: OpenAI is rolling out new business profiles and features designed to turn ChatGPT into a consumer discovery engine.
body_html: OpenAI is introducing new features and business profiles aimed at transforming ChatGPT into a stronger consumer discovery engine. The updates are designed to empower businesses to connect with users directly through the platform. By introducing these tools, the chatbot takes on functionalities comparable to traditional search and discovery platforms like Google, helping consumers find relevant business information within the AI interface.
